Attacks starting from Upgrade 7 are able to hit air type enemies.

==Passive Ability: Shade Birth==
Summons a Shade Birth after taking down 10 enemies (max 3), the Shade Birth will have 5x of his displayed damage. 

* [[Zombie (Risen)]] increases the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns in by 25% of each placement (up to 200%). Buffs to {{PAGENAME}} by Elfy (Slyph), Wind Dragon or Idol, do not affect the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns with.
* [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] and [[Commander]] increase the amount of damage Shade Birth does when colliding with an enemy.
* You can increase the damage the Shade Birth does by increasing {{PAGENAME}}'s base damage stats: having high [[Powerups|stat potential]], [[Traits]] that increase damage and [[Relics]].
* Shade Birth does not do Dark damage like {{PAGENAME}}, instead only doing physical.

==Active Ability: Nihilism==
[[File:Supreme Being (Sovereign) Passive.png|left|thumb|103x103px]]
Once Activated, a 12-second interval will appear above {{PAGENAME}}, once the time ticks down to zero, any enemy in the range of Supreme Being will take 5x of his damage, enemies who are caught by this also have a purple effect around them.


==Selling==
Unit sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
*He is the second {{Rarity|Secret}} unit added in the game that is not limited-time. The first unit being [[Lulu]].
*In the winter event his Shade Births have a spawn cap of 3 per path and thus can have 9 of them at the same time.
*Before update 18.5, he need at least 50 kills in order to summon a Shade Birth. From update 19.0, his passive requirement has been buff with only required 1 kill in order to summon.
**However from update 19.5, he has received a nerf, making his kill requirement into 10 kills in order to summon.
